inflation_cpi.sourceName: Bureau of Budget and Planning (Ministry of Finance), CPI 2026 Q2 key figures
inflation_cpi.note: All-groups CPI up 3.0% year on year in the June 2026 quarter (2.2% on the quarter). World Bank gives -0.4% for 2025.

inflation_projection.sourceName: IMF WEO CPI projections for Palau (1.7% 2026, 3.7% 2027, 2.1-2.5% 2028-2030); dollar economy
inflation_projection.note: Palau uses the US dollar and imports most goods, so we plan with 2.5%, a little above the Federal Reserve's 2% goal, in line with the IMF medium-term path.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics (US Federal Reserve federal funds target range)
policy_rate.note: Palau has no central bank and uses the US dollar; the federal funds target range 3.75-4.00% (held 28 October 2026) applies, midpoint used.

savings_account_rate.note: No published savings rates for banks in Palau were found; the Financial Institutions Commission publishes no rate statistics on the pages read.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published term deposit (CD) rates for banks in Palau were found.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published term deposit (CD) rates for banks in Palau were found.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product is known in Palau.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no Palau data and the Ministry of Finance quarterly indicators do not report deposit rates.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Palau issues no government savings certificates or retail bonds.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Palau issues no treasury bills (it uses the US dollar); US 3-month bills yielded about 4.09% on 30 Oct 2026 (4.08% on 2 Nov).

tbond_5y_rate.note: Palau issues no domestic government bonds.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Palau issues no domestic government bonds.

tax_bank_interest.note: The Palau Division of Revenue and Taxation page sets wage tax (6/10/12%) and 10% non-resident withholding on interest, but says nothing on residents' bank interest.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists in Palau.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No Palau deposit insurance scheme was found; whether US FDIC cover extends to branches of US-chartered banks in Palau was not confirmed.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate for Palau was found.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No local stock market; global equity in USD terms. US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund held in US dollars after a weak decade.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No local stock market; global equity in USD terms. US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
equity_return_base.note: No local exchange exists, so base equity is a global index in US dollars, set at the local safe-rate assumption of 1.5% plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No local stock market; global equity in USD terms. US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
equity_return_high.note: High case near the long-run return of global shares in US dollars.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Palau uses the US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF = 1)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price; no currency effect.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Palau uses the US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF = 1)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% with no currency depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Palau uses the US dollar (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF = 1)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: local savings accounts at low rates.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: local term deposits, assumed well below US bill yields because local banks have few lending outlets.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: dollar term deposits or bills near US short rates, less tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No life insurance claims data or insurance regulator statistics for Palau were found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term life premium rates for Palau were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical hospital bill was found; Belau National Hospital is public and complex cases go through the Medical Referral Program.

health_premium_table.note: No private health insurance premium table for Palau was found.

oop_health_share.note: 2023 figure, the latest World Bank year (older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Palau CPI 2026 Q2: health group 0.0% year on year, all items 3.0%
goal_inflation_health.note: The health group has been flat recently, but referral care abroad is priced in US medical costs, so we plan with headline plus one point.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Palau CPI 2026 Q2: education group 0.0% year on year, all items 3.0%
goal_inflation_education.note: The education group has been flat recently; we plan with headline plus half a point for study abroad costs.

life_expectancy.note: 2024 figure, the latest World Bank year (older than 2025). Men 67.3, women 71.9.

life_table_remaining.note: No UN WPP or WHO life table for Palau was found on the sources read (populationpyramid.net has no Palau page; WHO GHO does not cover it).

support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio 16.85 (2025). No 2040 or 2065 projection was found on the sources read.

retirement_age_default.note: Palau Social Security Administration rules could not be read (its site did not resolve and SSA/ILO/ISSA profiles refused access).

retirement_age_government.note: The Civil Service Pension Plan retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published

retirement_return_base.sourceName: US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
retirement_return_base.note: Base case set at an assumed local 1-year deposit rate, well under US bill yields.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
retirement_return_high.note: High case: dollar deposits or bills near US short rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: No local market; balanced global mix in USD. US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of global shares and dollar deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: No local market; balanced global mix in USD. US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: half global shares at 5.5% and half deposits at 1.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: No local market; balanced global mix in USD. US 3-month Treasury bill 4.09% (30 Oct 2026) as the dollar ceiling; local bank deposit rates are not published
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning global mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension for Palau was found; old-age income comes from Social Security and the Civil Service Pension Plan, whose pages could not be read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension for Palau was found.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory gratuity or end-of-service benefit for private employees was found for Palau.

public_pension_scheme.note: Palau Social Security (contributory old-age pension) exists, but its pension age and rules could not be read from an official source.

savings_account.note: Offered by the commercial banks licensed in Palau; rates not published.

fdr_3m.note: Banks in Palau offer time deposits; rates not published.

fdr_1y.note: Banks in Palau offer time deposits; rates not published.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificates or retail bonds.

tbill_91d.note: Palau issues no treasury bills; it uses the US dollar.

equity_fund.note: No local stock exchange or locally sold funds; residents would have to invest abroad.

gold.note: No local gold bullion dealer was found; no legal restriction is known.

centralBank.name: US Federal Reserve (Palau uses the US dollar and has no central bank)

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health and Human Services (Belau National Hospital, Medical Referral Program)

statistics.name: Bureau of Budget and Planning, Ministry of Finance (statistics: CPI, national accounts, census)
